source.label: Fiscal 2025 Form 10-K, income taxes note, taxes paid by jurisdiction
source.quote: The following table sets forth total taxes paid, net of refunds received, by jurisdiction: ... Total State and Local taxes paid, net of refunds received 0.22 Foreign: Ireland 0.04 Total Taxes Paid, net of refund received $ 0.26 [USD millions]

notes: Fiscal year ended January 31, 2026. Taxes: total taxes paid, net of refunds received ($0.26 million: state and local 0.22, Ireland 0.04), from the new by-jurisdiction table in the income-tax note (RTR adopted ASU 2023-09 for fiscal 2025); stored in billions as 0.00026. No federal income tax was paid. R&D is not reported as a separate line; the 'Technology' expense line (39.3m) covers technology payroll, professional services and software fees and is not labelled research and development.
